en: Sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story residential and commercial buildings. A few pedestrians and a cyclist move along the street, and a horse-drawn cart is visible in the middle distance. The architecture appears late 19th to early 20th century European. At the top center, the caption reads "Cottbuser Straße", and on the right-hand building there is a sign with the word "Atelier".
